text:
alex: hey team — accepted the org invite but when I visit https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference I see zero repos under 'Your repositories'. 2FA is on. any ideas?

devex-bot: GitHub Invite Event — invite accepted for alex (alex@example.com). Note: some repos require SSO authorization.

maria: welcome! quick checklist: 1) confirm invite email matches GH account email, 2) authorize SSO at https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/sso, 3) add SSH key under Profile → Settings → SSH and GPG keys. sometimes team perms take a few minutes after onboarding automation.

jamal: try `ssh -T git@github.com` and paste output. if it says Permission denied, your key isn't added or agent isn't loaded.

alex: ran that; got `Permission denied (publickey)`. i added my key a couple minutes ago.

jamal: run `ssh-add -l`. if you see no keys, `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa` (or your key path) then retry `ssh -T`.

irene: infra repos are private and SSO-enforced. even with SSH working you must be in infra-team to view them. post your GH handle and i'll check team membership.

alex: handle is alex-dev. after `ssh-add` `ssh -T` returns: "Hi alex-dev! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access." still only seeing public repos; infra repo returns 403.

maria: SSH looks good. next is org-team mapping — onboarding bot sometimes misses a team assignment. jamal or irene can add you to infra-team.

jamal: adding alex-dev to infra-team now. give it 5-10 minutes for GitHub to sync.

devex-bot: Onboarding automation: team sync queued for alex-dev (job id: 89231).

alex: refreshed — can clone infra repo now, access granted. thanks! :thumbsup:

maria: great — welcome aboard! ping #eng-ops if anything else blocks your setup.

jamal: noted — i'll update the onboarding ticket to ensure team mapping triggers reliably for future hires.
